name: Dominion
metaDescription: Free Dominion score calculator for 2–4 players. Count Estates, Duchies, Provinces, Curses and Gardens, with Colonies and VP tokens from Prosperity.
intro: At the end of Dominion everyone dumps their deck on the table and counts Victory cards. Enter how many of each card each player has and the calculator works out the totals, including Gardens.

categories.label: Gardens points

tiebreaker: If players are tied, the tied player who had the fewest turns wins. If they had the same number of turns, they share the victory.

rules.heading: How scoring works in Dominion
body: The game ends at the end of a turn when either the Province pile is empty or any three Supply piles are empty. Every player then collects all of their cards (hand, deck, discard pile and anything set aside) and counts the victory points.

rules.heading: Basic Victory cards and Curses
body: An Estate is worth 1 point, a Duchy 3 and a Province 6. Each Curse is worth −1. Every player starts with 3 Estates, so remember to count them.

rules.heading: Gardens and other Victory cards
body: Gardens is worth 1 point for every full 10 cards in your deck, so 38 cards makes each Gardens worth 3. Count your whole deck once and multiply by the number of Gardens you own.
Expansions add many Victory cards with their own rules, such as Duke (worth 1 per Duchy). Work out their value and enter the total in the 'Other' row.

rules.heading: Prosperity
body: When Prosperity's Colonies are in the game, each Colony is worth 10 points and the game also ends if the Colony pile runs out. Victory point tokens earned during the game are worth 1 point each.

faq.q: How many points is a Province worth?
faq.a: 6 points. A Duchy is 3, an Estate is 1 and a Curse is −1.
Each Gardens is worth 1 point per 10 cards in your deck, rounded down.

faq.q: Who wins a tie in Dominion?
faq.a: The tied player who took fewer turns. If they had the same number of turns, the win is shared.
